cron-fail-closed.ref: New TIER-2 cron `overdue-reply-alert` (apps/nickstire/server/cron/scheduler.ts) -> alertOverdueObligations(). Fail-closed evidence in server/humanPendingAlerts.test.ts (10 tests): (1) 'propagates a database failure rather than reporting an empty queue' -- listOverdueHumanPending THROWS when the DB is unavailable, so the cron reports a FAILED job instead of rendering an unreadable queue as 'nobody is waiting' (the ROS-059 silent-IDLE shape); (2) 'does NOT mark an obligation alerted when delivery failed' -- the 60-min throttle is written only on confirmed Telegram delivery, so an outage cannot buy an hour of silence, and the miss logs OVERDUE_ALERT_UNDELIVERED; (3) 'alerts once, then throttles the same obligation on the next sweep' -- bounded re-alerting. businessHoursOnly, so an obligation accrued overnight surfaces at opening rather than 3am. NON-CUSTOMER PATH: this cron messages the OPERATOR only and has no send-to-customer capability. NOT production-verified -- a live tick needs a deploy.
